items.title: Ella Langley’s ‘Choosin’ Texas’ Finally Breaks Mariah Carey’s All-Time Record for Weeks at No. 1, Eclipsing ‘All I Want for Christmas Is You’
items.summary: There’s no long tail like a “Choosin’ Texas” long tail. Ella Langley’s smash has just set the all-time record for the most weeks spent by a single at No. 1 on the Billboard Hot 100 chart: 23.

items.title: Lionel Richie Undergoes Heart Procedure, ‘Will Be Back on Stage Soon’ After Canceling Next Three Shows
items.summary: Lionel Richie will miss at least a few concert dates after being hospitalized this week and undergoing a procedure to treat atrial fibrillation, the singer’s rep says.

items.title: Blue Bendy Launch New Album With “Dragonslayer” Video
items.summary: One Day This Will All Be Lore’s lead single presents “nationalistic mythology wrapped in a tragicomic romantic pop song”

items.title: Ella Langley’s ‘Choosin’ Texas’ Is Now the Most Popular Song in Billboard Chart History
items.summary: With 23 weeks at the top, the song has officially beaten Mariah Carey’s Hot 100 Record

items.title: Apple to Open Concert Venue Inside of London’s Battersea Power Station
items.summary: The 600-capacity Apple Music Hall will boast a 48-speaker Spatial Audio system, dedicated recording studios, and multi-camera broadcast capabilities.
